observations: A truck-mounted borehole drilling rig: an orange lattice drilling mast and rotary head assembly mounted on the rear chassis of a white cab-over truck.
Truck cab front grille shows 'Nissan Diesel' and a 'UD' emblem (photo 0 and photo 2).
Windshield carries a hand-written/sticker notice reading something like 'Best Pako Steering, No Hand Signal' - an aftermarket joke sticker, not a specification.
Mast has stencilled letters (looks like 'FR' or similar) but no full brand/model plate is legible in any photo.
Hydraulic hoses are coiled on top of the mast in photo 1, showing surface wear, dust and some discoloration.
Body and mast show rust staining, chipped paint, and general yard dust/dirt consistent with heavy outdoor use.
Vehicle is parked in a yard among other heavy equipment (a wheel loader and a forklift), with a number plate visible but not fully legible.
No photo shows the engine running, the compressor unit, the mud/air hose connections in operation, or any drilling demonstration.
No photo shows tires close-up, chassis underside, or the mast in raised/drilling position actually working.

read_from: photo 2 grille badge and UD emblem

claims.evidence: No engine-running, compressor-running, or drilling-in-action photo/video is provided; only static yard photos.
Mast and truck are visually present, but no demonstration of drilling function, hydraulic pressure, or rotary head operation is shown.

claims.claim: Buy to site, condition for very serious buyers (implying as-is, no inspection)
claims.evidence: This is a sales condition, not a verifiable fact from any photo.

risks.risk: Engine and drilling rig may not actually run or drill (claim 'working fine' unproven).
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting, compressor running, and the mast raising/drilling for at least a few meters.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working / for-parts drilling rig

risks.risk: Hydraulic hoses and pump may be leaking or perished (hoses show wear/dust in photo 1).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of hose fittings and a short clip of hydraulics being pressurized without leaks.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming hydraulic system needs full replacement

risks.risk: Air compressor (key costly component of a drilling rig) condition and presence is not confirmed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the compressor unit with its nameplate/model and a photo/video of it running.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming compressor is non-functional or missing

risks.risk: Truck chassis, tires, and brakes condition for roadworthiness/transport to site.
risks.proof: Photos of all tires, chassis underside, and brake lines.

risks.risk: Ownership documents, registration, and import/customs papers not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle particulars, customs papers, and proof of ownership matching the plate number.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming no clean title, add legal/registration risk

risks.risk: Mast and derrick structural fatigue or cracks hidden under rust/paint.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of weld joints and pins on the mast, plus a clip of the mast raising fully.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming mast requires structural inspection/repair

proof_requests: Video of engine starting and running, with compressor engaged.
Video of the mast raising, rotary head turning, and a short drilling/mud circulation demonstration.
Close-up photos of the compressor nameplate and hydraulic hose fittings.
Photos of all tires, chassis underside, and brake components.
Photo of vehicle registration/particulars and any ownership/customs documents matching the plate number.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig on a Nissan Diesel/UD chassis, but no photo or claim proves it runs or drills, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working rig pending the listed proofs.
